extra-us-fair-lawn-bris-avrohom.name: Bris Avrohom of Fair Lawn
extra-us-fair-lawn-bris-avrohom.note: Jewish Link, 6 Aug 2026 (after Rabbi Berel Zaltzman's passing; as summarized in data/extra-centers.json): founded in 1993 by Rabbi Berel and Rebbetzin Chaya Esther Zaltzman, now led by their son Rabbi Mendel and Elke Zaltzman. Medium: one secondary source. Official since the owner's word (Nov 10, 2026).

extra-us-jersey-city-bris-avrohom.name: Bris Avrohom of Jersey City
extra-us-jersey-city-bris-avrohom.note: Bris Avrohom began in Jersey City in 1979 (Rabbi Mordechai Kanelsky; Jewish Link, 28 Aug 2019, 'Bris Avrohom Celebrates Forty Years': in the early 1980s the new Soviet immigrants lived in Newark, Jersey City and Irvington; 'The third headquarters of Bris Avrohom is on 35 Cottage Street in Jersey City and is directed by Rabbi Boruch and Kreina Lepkevker'). Medium: the year is the network's start in the city; when this branch itself opened is not stated. Official since the owner's word (Nov 10, 2026).
